Second read (read-only) of head afde911099ed581d9f68567e30401b9a24e35f8a: the workflow change.

Verdict: clean. I did not build. I read the diff (`origin/main...pr-3254`, 4 files, +16/-6) and the full `cut.yml`.

1. Triggers: the `on:` block is the same as on `main`. It has `workflow_dispatch` only (`cut.yml` lines 30-31). The PR adds no `push`, `pull_request`, `pull_request_target`, `schedule`, `workflow_run` or `issue_comment` trigger. A fork PR cannot start this workflow.
2. The only functional change is `runs-on`, in two jobs:
   - `gate` (line 65): `[self-hosted, linux]` -> `[self-hosted, camcraft-cut]`
   - `tag` (line 151): `[self-hosted, linux]` -> `[self-hosted, camcraft-cut]`

   The diff has no other changed lines in `cut.yml`. The steps, `run:` lines, `permissions:` (top level `contents: read`, `gate` read, `tag` write), secrets, `uses:` actions, checkout refs (`release/v${{ inputs.version }}`, `main`) do not change. The diff adds no `continue-on-error`.
3. Result after the merge: a runner must have the two labels `self-hosted` and `camcraft-cut` to take a job. The list does not include `linux`. If no runner has `camcraft-cut`, a `cut.yml` run stays in the queue. Thus, add the label to the cut runner before the merge, as the PR body and the decision file say.
4. Text changes:
   - `AGENTS.md` line 722: "`cut.yml` runs the release tier of a cut on `[self-hosted, camcraft-cut]`: only a runner given that label takes it, never a post-merge or PR-test runner (#3253)."
   - `runners` skill: the `runs-on` value changes to `[self-hosted, camcraft-cut]`. The label list changes to `self-hosted`, `Linux`, `X64` and `camcraft-cut`, with "Only the cut runner carries `camcraft-cut`."

   No rule is weakened or removed. The safety rules on triggers do not change. The PR body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
5. The closing keyword is `Fixes #3253`.

Note (not a defect): the job no longer requires a `linux` label. The skill still requires Linux x86-64 for the runner that has `camcraft-cut`, so this is correct if only that machine gets the label.

Coordinator: this PR merges now. The maintainer decided in chat on 2026-11-22: "PR 3254 - yes - merge..". This ends the `needs-maintainer` hold.

- Class: no refresh. The PR merges cleanly with `main`.
- Review: the collaborator marker on head afde91109 (comment 7070362660, no blocking findings), and the read-only second read of the workflow change in comment 7077981203 (the `on:` block is `workflow_dispatch` only; the two `runs-on` lines are the only change in `cut.yml`).
- After the merge, a `cut.yml` run waits in the queue until a self-hosted runner has the label `camcraft-cut`. The maintainer adds that label to the cut runner.
- Process change: the merging session makes the `PROCESS_VERSION` PR after this merge.
